mentions.heading: We may not be able to respond quickly enough to changes in regulations, technology and to develop IP into viable products.
mentions.detail: Disruptive technologies like autonomous driving, ADAS and alternative-fuel vehicles; innovation requires extensive capital investment
mentions.quote: Our ability to respond to competitive pressures and react quickly to other major changes in the marketplace, including the potential introduction of disruptive technologies such as autonomous driving solutions or consumer desire for and availability of vehicles with advanced driver assistance technologies or which use alternative fuels is also a risk to our future financial performance.

mentions.heading: Changes in regulations may render products obsolete
mentions.detail: DOT guidance on automated driving systems; possible pre-approval requirements and divergent jurisdictional rules
mentions.quote: There remains potential for the continued introduction of new and expanded regulations in this space, including potential requirements for autonomous vehicle systems to receive approval from the DOT or other regulatory agencies prior to commercial introduction. It is also possible that regulations in this space may diverge among jurisdictions, leading to increased compliance costs.

mentions.heading: Failure to launch new product programs on schedule
mentions.detail: Equipment certification and facility transitions for new programs; dependence on customer launch schedules
mentions.quote: Our failure to successfully launch new products, or a failure by our customers to successfully launch new programs, could adversely affect our results.

mentions.heading: Certain of our businesses rely on collaborative partners and third-parties for product development, which could fail to perform.
mentions.detail: Partners may underinvest, be acquired, compete, or not renew; could delay or cancel development programs
mentions.quote: If we or any of our collaborative partners terminate a collaborative arrangement, we may be required to devote additional resources to product development and commercialization or may need to cancel certain development programs, which could adversely affect our business and operational results.
